description:
The Rust team has released Rust 1.98.0, an update to the language that introduces algebraic methods for floating-point operations.

Developers who have a previous version of Rust installed via rustup can update to Rust 1.98.0 by running rustup update stable.

title: Rust language adds algebraic floating-point methods
